tasks.notes: Grounding source: official Charades action class c062 is ‘Putting some food somewhere’; the official mapping file maps c062 to source object class o016 (‘food’) and verb v016. Choosing one YCB banana and a clear kitchen surface makes a bounded Atlas collection proposal; neither that particular fruit identity nor the target surface is stated by the broad class label. The Charades-to-YCB mapping is proposed, with model equivalence and asset compatibility unknown. Atlas graph walk (exactly two local edges): this TaskInstance --acts_on--> ycb_011_banana (ObjectInstance) --instance_of--> concept:object_fruit (ObjectClass). This is the first of two distinct sibling primitives under object_fruit; its companion is task_reference_charades_take_apple_from_surface_round1. Charades scripted video labels are dataset evidence only, not population frequency or physical robot execution.

Atlas graph walk (exactly two local edges): this TaskInstance --acts_on--> ycb_013_apple (ObjectInstance) --instance_of--> concept:object_fruit (ObjectClass). draft_notes: This is an isolated proposed bundle. It adds two source-grounded primitive proposals and does not modify active seeds or YCB coverage batches.

The official Charades v1 class list defines c062 as ‘Putting some food somewhere’ and c063 as ‘Taking food from somewhere’. The official class-to-object/verb mapping gives o016 (‘food’) for each, with verbs v016 and v023 respectively. The official README documents the action classes, mapping file, and temporal annotations. These exact source classes—not an invented annotation row—ground the two tasks.

The source label ‘food’ is broader than Task Atlas concept:object_fruit. Selecting YCB banana for c062 and YCB apple for c063 is a curator-proposed narrowing to reusable objects already in the YCB catalog. Charades provides no evidence that either recorded video object is the selected YCB model; equivalence and physical/simulator compatibility are unknown.

Each local hierarchy walk has exactly two edges: task_reference_charades_put_banana_on_surface_round1 --acts_on--> ycb_011_banana --instance_of--> concept:object_fruit; task_reference_charades_take_apple_from_surface_round1 --acts_on--> ycb_013_apple --instance_of--> concept:object_fruit. The second task is a distinct sibling primitive under the same ObjectClass.

The two candidate tasks are not represented as observed population frequencies or robot demonstrations. Charades is a crowdsourced scripted video dataset; no video/action-class prevalence is reported as human household frequency, and no task is claimed as physically executed by a robot.

The scene, specified surface, initial/goal states, safety checks, and collection steps narrow generic action classes into proposed data-collection procedures. All setup, execution, reset, and review times remain null because no Task Atlas collection trial was measured.
